content.short: Bitpowr provides blockchain wallet and digital asset custody for businesses.
content.description: Bitpowr offers an integrated platform with APIs and SDKs designed for businesses to manage thousands of wallets across a wide range of blockchains. It provides programmable MPC custody solutions to secure digital assets, enable on-chain payments, and support regulatory compliance. From core wallet infrastructure and custody to settlement, tokenization, and crypto accounting, Bitpowr delivers a complete suite of digital asset services and infrastructure.
content.meta: Bitpowr offers an all-in-one platform with APIs and SDKs to manage wallets across blockchains. Discover Bitpowr and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
